tool.name: Biomni: Find Restriction Enzymes
tool.description: Finds common restriction enzyme sites in a DNA sequence.
tool.help:
**Biomni: Find Restriction Enzymes**
Finds common restriction enzyme sites in a DNA sequence.
Args: sequence (str): DNA sequence to analyze is_circular (bool): Whether the sequence is circular (default: False)
Returns: Dict[str, list]: Dictionary of enzymes and their cut positions
**Domain**: molecular_biology **Function**: find_restriction_enzymes
